SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name, city, region, format, sqm, open_date, close_date, valid_from, valid_to, is_current
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE store_id < 900 GROUP BY store_id HAVING count(*) > 1 OR max(close_date) IS NOT NULL OR max(open_date) IS NOT NULL) OR store_id >= 900
ORDER BY store_id, valid_from

FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
ORDER BY sqm DESC
LIMIT 14

calls.statement:
SELECT r.store_id, s.store_name, s.sqm, round(sum(r.net_sales),0) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(r.net_sales) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = r.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND r.store_id < 900
GROUP BY r.store_id, s.store_name, s.sqm
ORDER BY net_sales_fy2025_26 DESC
LIMIT 12
